thesis: The strongest challenge to ALAB is not business quality but expectations and concentration. The company combines excellent liquidity, rapid adoption and expanding product breadth with a $56B market cap, a Base DCF below the cutoff price, high direct-customer concentration, material SBC and dependence on hyperscale AI infrastructure. The compounder case remains economically plausible, but the evidence does not justify dismissing permanent-loss and dilution concerns.

evidence.claim: Current price $303.25 is above the locked Base value $284.56 but well below Bull $808.46.
Q2 direct-customer revenue shares were 29%, 25%, 15% and 13%, establishing concentrated commercial exposure even though some direct customers are manufacturing partners.
H1 2026 SBC was $112.9M while H1 operating cash flow was $162.3M, showing that equity compensation remains economically material.
June liquidity was about $1.253B with negligible funded debt, sharply limiting financing and bankruptcy risk.
The Amazon warrant can cover up to 3.262M shares and is linked to purchase-performance conditions, illustrating both customer validation and bargaining power concentrated with a major customer.

counterevidence: Q2 revenue grew 104% YoY and Q3 guidance implies another large sequential increase.
GAAP gross margin remained above 70%, arguing against subsidy-driven adoption.
Product breadth has expanded from retimers into switching, memory, Ethernet and optical/custom connectivity.
Net cash and positive OCF make forced financing unlikely.
unknowns: Ultimate end-customer mapping behind manufacturing partners.
Scorpio's sustainable share after competitor responses.
How severe an AI infrastructure downcycle would be for owner FCF/share.
falsifiers: Meaningful diversification of end customers would weaken the concentration bear case.
Sustained diluted-share growth below 3% with rising FCF/share would weaken the dilution bear case.
A lower stock price or materially higher owner-FCF path could improve permanent-loss asymmetry without changing business quality.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: No restatement, auditor dispute, material-control failure or integrity event was identified in the reviewed primary filings.
ALAB is net cash and operating-cash-flow positive, so external financing is not structurally required for survival.
Triple-digit revenue growth with >70% GAAP gross margin and production design wins demonstrates paid customer value rather than subsidy-led demand.
Revenue, operating income and cash generation expanded alongside R&D investment; no structural collapse in incremental returns is established.
Product breadth, co-design and qualification depth are expanding rather than showing persistent moat contraction.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Current price is above Base but substantially below Bull value, so Bull+ is not required.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Customer concentration is high, but product families and multiple end-market programs reduce the case for a fatal single-product dependency. End-customer mapping remains incomplete, so this should remain under review.
